question: Holiday gift idea: wireless earbuds for a runner who needs a secure fit, on sale.
intro: For a runner who needs a secure fit, several earbuds combine stability, sweat resistance and holiday discounts.

steps.text: A wingtip pair that locks into the ear ridge, with physical buttons and sweat resistance. Noted on sale, up to 36% off.
An ear-hook pair with an “unshakeable fit” and up to 10 hours per charge.
A value pair with soft silicone wings that often drops in price during sales.
A budget ear-hook pair with long battery life and a charging cable built into the case.
Many stores are already running early holiday discounts on these models.
